questions.question: Your recent experience centers on OBIEE repositories, dashboards, and Oracle SQL. Can you describe a challenging reporting-performance issue you diagnosed, the evidence you used to isolate the cause, and the changes you made?
How have you translated business requirements into an OBIEE RPD, data model, and set of reports or dashboards? Please walk through a specific project from requirement analysis through unit testing.

This role requires Python application development. What Python experience do you have, and how would you structure a Python service that retrieves data from an Oracle database and exposes it through a REST API?
Describe your experience using SQL with Oracle to investigate data-quality or performance issues. What types of queries, indexing considerations, or database-side changes did you use?
In your work on OBIEE upgrades and repository changes, how did you plan, test, and deploy changes across development, SIT/QA, and production environments?
Tell me about a time you collaborated with ETL, QA, database, and business teams during defect triage. How did you establish ownership, communicate status, and drive the issue to closure?

If you were building a React-based interface backed by Python APIs for an internal research-delivery application, how would you define the API contracts, error handling, authentication considerations, and testing approach?
What unit, system, and integration testing practices have you used for reports, repository changes, and production defect fixes? How would those practices translate to a Python web application?
Describe a proof of concept you developed for a new project proposal. What problem was it intended to validate, what did you build, and how did you present the outcome to stakeholders?

This team works in a globally distributed Agile environment. Based on your experience as an onsite coordinator and module lead, how have you managed task assignment, handoffs, peer reviews, and communication across teams?
